next.reason: 1985: "must be described in a file description entry, not in a sort-merge description entry"; 2023: "shall be described in a file description entry that is not for a report file and is not a sort-merge file description entry". 2023 also excludes report files as USING/GIVING files. The 1985 rule refuses only sort-merge entries, so 2023 refuses programs this rule alone accepts.
